takes.title: Steady jog across the capture space
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves through successive jogging strides with compact arm swings, staying at a steady cadence through the last pose.
takes.reviewNote: Source starts with 55 all-zero captured frames. First usable motion is recorded at source frame 56.

takes.title: Neutral walk with even footfalls
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks through several even steps with relaxed shoulders, a narrow stance, and a small alternating arm swing.

takes.title: Stiff walk with arms forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds both arms out in front, takes measured strides with a stiff upper body, and keeps the arms raised through the end.

takes.title: Continuous jog with high heel recovery
takes.actionDescription: The performer jogs throughout the take with bent elbows, lifting each heel behind on alternating strides.

takes.title: Short jog into a stand
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, builds into a short sequence of jogging steps, then slows and settles with the feet apart.

takes.title: Start jogging from standing
takes.actionDescription: The performer shifts forward from a relaxed stance, bends the elbows, and accelerates into a jog that continues through the finish.

takes.title: Standing weight shifts and arm gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer changes between hands at the waist and hands near the chest, turns the head and shoulders, and settles with the arms lowered.

takes.title: Jog start with a preparatory lean
takes.actionDescription: The performer pauses with feet planted, leans forward into the first step, then establishes a quicker jogging cadence with bent arms.

takes.title: Jog to a relaxed stand
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins mid-jog, shortens the last few steps, and lets the arms drop while coming upright.

takes.title: Jog to a wide-foot stop
takes.actionDescription: The performer transitions from springy running strides to short braking steps, finishes with the feet apart, and lowers the hands.

takes.title: Bouncy walk with sweeping gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes exaggerated springing steps, alternates high leg swings and broad arm reaches, and keeps moving through the finish.

takes.title: Excited walk with high steps and reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer bounds forward with high knees, dips and extends both arms out, then adds an overhead reach in the last few steps.

takes.title: Staggering walk with repeated catches
takes.actionDescription: The performer lurches through uneven steps, throws the arms out and up to recover, and finishes with another forward lean and cross-step.

takes.title: Exaggerated walk start
takes.actionDescription: The performer pauses upright, starts with a high step and a diagonal arm reach, then accelerates with forward leans and springing steps.

takes.title: Staggered stance with both arms forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer keeps the arms lifted in front and the knees soft, holding a near-static staggered stance.

takes.title: Erratic traveling gait
takes.actionDescription: The performer leans and pitches through long, uneven steps, swinging one arm overhead and reaching the other outward for balance.

takes.title: Erratic gait into an upright stop
takes.actionDescription: The performer enters with a long lurching step and one arm raised, corrects with smaller crossing steps, and comes to a stand.

takes.title: Lurching steps into a stop
takes.actionDescription: After the opening reference frames, the performer travels with exaggerated arm reaches and forward bends, then shortens the steps and settles upright.
takes.reviewNote: Source starts with 113 all-zero captured frames. First usable motion is recorded at source frame 114.

takes.title: Casual straight walk to a stop
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts from standing, takes relaxed forward steps with small arm swings, and settles back into a quiet stance.

takes.title: Walk after lowering an outstretched arm
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with one arm extended sideways, lowers it and walks with a moderate stride, then stops with both arms at the sides.

takes.title: Short straight walk and stop
takes.actionDescription: The performer pauses upright, walks forward with an alternating arm swing, and decelerates to a standing finish.
takes.reviewNote: Source starts with 5 all-zero captured frames. First usable motion is recorded at source frame 6.

takes.title: Regular walk through a figure eight
takes.actionDescription: The performer follows successive curved paths at a regular pace, turning in opposite directions and returning to a quiet stand.

takes.title: Looping walk after an open-arm setup
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers both arms from the opening pose, walks through several changes of facing with a steady stride, and stops.

takes.title: Looping walk with a one-arm setup
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers one extended arm, starts walking with a soft arm swing, curves through several directions, and finishes facing near the start.

takes.title: Walk with repeated changes of direction
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers from an open-arm pose into a measured walk, taking several angled direction changes before coming to a stop.

takes.title: Standing bends and squat into an open-arm pose
takes.actionDescription: The performer shifts between side bends and arm gestures, lowers into a wide squat with both arms out, then rises and holds the arms level.

takes.title: Regular walk with right-angle turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes regular steps along straight stretches, changes direction in distinct corners, and comes to a stop.

takes.title: Brisk stern walk into a stop
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with feet apart, takes several purposeful steps with a compact arm swing, then returns to a quiet stand.

takes.title: Short stern walk with bent elbows
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps off with the elbows bent close to the body, walks briskly for several strides, and relaxes the arms at the stop.

takes.title: Stern walk through a figure eight
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks at a brisk cadence with firm steps and flexed elbows, changing facing through two loops before stopping.

takes.title: Brisk loop with compact arm swings
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers one raised arm and begins a brisk walk, curves around with the elbows bent, and returns to standing.

takes.title: Stern walk with right-angle turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes long purposeful steps and leans into successive corner turns before slowing to a stop.

takes.title: Brisk walk with turns after an arm raise
takes.actionDescription: The performer drops a sideways arm from the opening pose, walks with firm strides and small body leans through direction changes, then stops.

takes.title: Slow straight walk after an arm raise
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers the extended arm, takes measured steps with little upper-body movement, and comes back to a stand.

takes.title: Slow walk with relaxed arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes unhurried, even steps with a small natural arm swing, finishing upright with both feet planted.

takes.title: Slow walk through a figure eight
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves unhurriedly through curved paths in both directions, keeping the arms loose and settling upright at the end.

takes.title: Continuous run with compact arm drive
takes.actionDescription: The performer runs throughout the take, alternating quick knee drives and high heel recoveries with bent-arm swings.

takes.title: Unhurried walk with several turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks at a measured pace with modest arm swing, changes facing several times, and ends side-on.
takes.reviewNote: Source starts with 4 all-zero captured frames. First usable motion is recorded at source frame 5.

takes.title: Slow walk with right-angle turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer keeps an even, unhurried pace through straight stretches and distinct corners, then comes to a stop.

takes.title: Walk through several corners after an open-arm setup
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers both arms, walks with a long easy stride through changes of direction, and finishes with the feet planted.

takes.title: Straight zombie walk
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both forearms in front and advances with a stiff upper body and deliberate steps, then lowers the arms.

takes.title: Zombie walk through a figure eight
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds both arms forward while following successive curves, then releases the stiff stance and returns to a stand.

takes.title: Zombie walk through corner turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer extends the arms forward and walks in stiff, deliberate steps, pivots through sharp direction changes, and lowers the arms to finish.

takes.title: Stylized walk with shoulder sway
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks at a measured pace, letting the shoulder line tilt with each weight transfer, then settles into a quiet stand.

takes.title: Stylized figure-eight walk
takes.actionDescription: The performer follows curved paths in both directions with measured steps and a slight torso sway before coming upright at the finish.

takes.title: Stylized walk through right-angle turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks with a slight slouch and loose arms, changes direction at several corners, then stands with feet apart.

takes.title: Swaying walk after an open-arm setup
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers the arms, then takes steps with alternating side leans and loose arms before coming to a stand.

takes.title: Short continuous run
takes.actionDescription: The performer stays in a running cadence through the brief take, driving the knees and swinging the bent arms in opposition.

takes.title: Forward-leaning walk with repeated turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers an outstretched arm, walks with intermittent forward and side leans, then turns back to a quiet stance.

takes.title: Swaying walk with several direction changes
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps with a soft forward bend and occasional side tilt, changes direction several times, and comes upright at the stop.

takes.title: Short walk with bent-arm shifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers both arms from the opening pose, takes short brisk steps with changing elbow positions, and turns slightly at the finish.

takes.title: Leaning walk with bends and turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers one raised arm, walks into a series of forward and side bends while changing facing, then stops upright.

takes.title: Run start with a gradual forward lean
takes.actionDescription: The performer tips forward from standing, bends the elbows, and builds from the first steps into a full running stride.

takes.title: Quick run start from standing
takes.actionDescription: The performer leans sharply forward, pushes off and quickly drives the legs into a run, keeping the elbows close to the body.

takes.title: Run start after lowering one arm
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers the outstretched arm, pauses upright, then pumps the arms and transitions into a fast running stride.

takes.title: Running stop with a wide plant
takes.actionDescription: The performer is already running, shortens the stride across several braking steps, then plants the feet apart and lets the arms relax.

takes.title: Running stop with narrow final steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer comes in with a long running stride, takes progressively shorter steps, and settles upright with the arms at the sides.
